injuries.description: Clinically cerebral contusion; damage to the left side of her brain which has left her with partial paralysis of her right arm and right leg, memory disturbance and a slight risk of epilepsis.
source: the Plaintiff as a result of the accident has suffered damage to the left side of her brain which has left her with partial paralysis of her right arm and right leg and memory disturbance and also a slight risk of epilepsis which will continue for 20 years at a steadily decreasing rate.

injuries.description: Lost four central lower teeth which have had to be replaced by a denture.

injuries.description: Scarring of her right eyebrow, right upper lip and on the back of her right forearm.

source: She has scarring of her right eyebrow, right upper lip and also on the back of her right forearm.

manifestations.description: Partial paralysis of her right arm and right leg.
Slight risk of epilepsis which will continue for 20 years at a steadily decreasing rate.
Significant amount of intellectual deficit amounting to about 20% (difficulty with comprehension).
Apt to lose her temper very easily over trivial things (behavioural change not present prior to the accident).
Scarring of right eyebrow, right upper lip and back of right forearm (cosmetic/disfigurement).
Pain and suffering associated with broken arm and lacerations and abrasions.
Loss of four central lower teeth (required denture).

treatments_received: Discharged from Kwong Wah Hospital on the 8th November 1977
Attended follow-up treatment for a further three months on a daily basis
Replacement of four central lower teeth by a denture
treatments_future: Plastic surgery may probably right scarring (possible future plastic surgery)

losses.description: Scarring of right eyebrow, right upper lip and back of right forearm; scarring may be corrected by plastic surgery.
Partial paralysis of right arm and right leg caused by damage to the left side of the brain.
Partial paralysis affecting right leg (reduced mobility).
Memory disturbance and significant intellectual deficit (about 20%) with difficulty in comprehension.
Diminution of future earning capacity assessed at $800 per month with multiplier 10, total assessed $96,000.
Loss of four central lower teeth (replaced by a denture).
